skill.name: douyin-trend-insights
skill.description: 当用户需要做抖音趋势洞察、抖音趋势分析、热点观察、内容方向判断、趋势线索归纳或营销灵感整理时使用。面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Review Douyin rankings and keyword results to identify trends and plan content.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most flags were Markdown formatting, public vendor links, or configuration names. The workflow runs an unpinned npm package that can access a service credential, and its shell examples do not specify safe argument passing. No evidence found of an embedded secret, deliberate credential export, or an attempt to override the audit.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npm package runs during credential checks, login, and research.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an independently reviewed release with verified integrity. Require approval before installing it or running it with access to credentials.

remediation.issue: The CLI can access environment credentials and a persistent local key.
remediation.suggestion: Use an OS credential store where available. Run the CLI with only a dedicated service key and no access to unrelated secrets.

remediation.issue: The shell examples do not specify how to pass untrusted input safely.
remediation.suggestion: Pass each keyword and pagination token as a separate argument through a shell-free process API. Prefer structured MCP calls when available.

content.value_statement: A trending topic does not always tell you what to create next. Compare Douyin rankings with keyword search results to identify themes and plan what to test.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the current Douyin hot-search list without a keyword.
Search Douyin posts by keyword and filter by publication time, duration, or content type.
Use the provider's default search order, sort newest first, or sort by most likes.
Combine CLI result pages within a page or item limit and resume from a returned pagination token.
Summarize ranking signals and representative posts separately, with links or content IDs when returned.
limitations: Live retrieval requires an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or a configured, authenticated MCP connection.
Requests can consume SocialDataX credits and may return partial results.
Keyword search returns a sample, not a complete record of Douyin content.
The workflow does not post, like, comment, or modify Douyin accounts.

prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Get a snapshot of the current hot-search list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show five topics from the current Douyin hot-search list. Include their ranks and any popularity signals returned by the provider.

prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Sample recent posts for one topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for [keyword] using one page of results from the past week. Summarize recurring themes and cite up to three posts.

prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Check whether ranking topics appear in a targeted search.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the current hot-search list with videos under one minute about [topic] from the past week. Keep ranking data separate from search results.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Bounded Trend Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Assess a topic with a fixed research budget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] and sort by likes. Stop after [page limit] pages or [item limit] posts, whichever comes first. Cite examples and mark partial results. Separate observations from recommendations.

output_examples.input: Show the current Douyin rankings and suggest a topic for a meal planning channel.
output: Illustrative ranking: weekday lunch prep appears second on the sample hot-search list.
Suggested topic: compare two lunches that can be prepared in ten minutes.
Evidence limit: the ranking suggests current interest but does not predict how your audience will respond.

output_examples.input: Sample one page of Douyin posts about desk lighting from the past week.
output: Illustrative sample: posts focus on glare reduction and before-and-after desk setups.
Sample observation: the before-and-after posts show how the lighting changes on camera.
Next question: do posts about small desks show the same pattern?

best_practices: Start with one page, then agree on page and item limits before expanding the sample.
Report rankings and keyword results separately. Cite post links or IDs when available.
Use an approved connection for live calls and keep API keys out of prompts and logs.
anti_patterns: Treating hot-search ranks or a keyword sample as proof of platform-wide behavior.
Restarting a partial query from page one instead of using its returned cursor and remaining limits.
Pasting API keys or local credential files into the conversation.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a SocialDataX credential. An authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing setup.

faq.question: Do I need a keyword for the hot-search list?
faq.answer: No. A keyword is required only for content search.

faq.question: Can I search image posts as well as videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The content-type filter can return videos, image posts, or both.

faq.question: Can I retrieve every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete result set. Use a page or item limit for a bounded sample.

faq.question: What happens if the service runs out of credits?
faq.answer: The workflow stops retrying and reports the billing issue. It keeps any partial results and can resume when a valid cursor is available.

faq.question: Can this skill post or edit anything on Douyin?
faq.answer: No. The Douyin research workflow is read-only and does not modify accounts.
